purpose: Desktop website composition references. Not production mascot assets.

concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE finished, high-fidelity desktop website hero concept for OHMI, an electronics learning companion Chrome extension for college students. Landscape 1440x1000 composition, readable real typography and navigable website anatomy. Input 1 is the exact approved OHMI pixel-art mascot, preserve its exact design, silhouette, face, antennae, component details, original pixelated edges and proportions; use this as the hero subject, never a 3D reinterpretation. Input 2 is Nimbus mood/composition reference only: dark cinematic background, bold readable type, generous whitespace and a central friendly mascot, but adapt original OHMI branding and mint teal rather than blue. Premium graphic design, cohesive near-black green #071411 background, ivory #f5faf5 typography, mint #a0f0cd actions and accents. Self-hostable clean modern geometric sans character, heavy display but calm readable body. Navigation at top: small OHMI wordmark left, How it works and FAQ toward right, pill action 'Meet your buddy'. Exact main title: 'A little buddy.\nA brighter build.' Exact supporting copy: 'Meet OHMI, your learning companion for electronics, Arduino, and those why-isn’t-this-working moments.' Primary action 'Explore OHMI' and secondary 'See how it works'. Small honest source-build note 'Built for curious circuit builders.' No fake testimonials, numbers, store badges, verified-circuit claims or decorative data labels. This is a website comp with real text and controls, not a poster. No text boxes around every item. Show a narrow beginning of the next section at bottom to establish page continuation. Keep comfortable text contrast, sophisticated whitespace, nav and CTA fully visible, and mascot fully visible. CONCEPT A: 'Orbit'. Centered cinematic composition closest to the Nimbus reference. Strong two-line headline centered upper third. Supporting text and two actions below. Exact approved mascot centered lower half, floating in very subtle mint ambient light with a thin elliptical orbital line behind its feet. Sparse tiny square mint star pixels instead of many glowing stars. Two tiny, restrained example chat notes flank the lower mascot, labeled 'Illustrative preview', reading 'What does this resistor do?' and 'Let’s work it out together.' A mint rounded horizontal edge begins the next section at the bottom. Original, highly polished OHMI visual world.
